## Security and privacy review

Check every item that applies:

- [ ] This change does not add keyboard/typed-character capture
- [ ] New captured metadata is documented and minimized
- [ ] Screenshots remain local unless a user deliberately exports/shares them
- [ ] Any new network destination is explicit, validated, and privacy-documented
- [ ] Password/sensitive-field handling is preserved
- [ ] File paths from sessions or external input are canonicalized and constrained
- [ ] External process execution uses a trusted absolute executable path and structured arguments
- [ ] Secrets are not committed, logged, exported, or stored as plaintext
- [ ] GitHub Actions permissions remain least-privilege
- [ ] Dependency or action changes were checked for security impact
